questions.q: What is the difference between severity and priority on a defect log?
options: They mean exactly the same thing
Severity describes technical impact; priority describes urgency relative to the project schedule
Severity only applies to UAT defects; priority only applies to SIT defects
Priority is set by Oracle Support, severity by the project team
questions.explain: Severity describes how badly a defect breaks the system, independent of timing, while priority describes how urgently it needs fixing relative to the schedule and other open items.

questions.q: What is the purpose of "steps to reproduce" on a defect log entry?
options: To document the Executive Sponsor's approval
To calculate the defect's priority automatically
So anyone, not just the original finder, can recreate the problem
To replace the need for a test script
questions.explain: Steps to reproduce let any team member recreate the defect, not just the person who originally found it.

questions.q: What is the typical defect life cycle sequence?
options: New -> Assigned -> In Progress -> Fixed -> Retest -> Closed
Closed -> New -> Fixed -> Assigned
Fixed -> New -> Retest -> Assigned
In Progress -> Closed -> New
questions.explain: Defects typically move through New, Assigned, In Progress, Fixed, Retest, and finally Closed.

questions.q: What is the purpose of a triage meeting during active testing?
options: To approve the project charter
To schedule the quarterly update calendar
To sign off the Business Process Design document
To review new and unresolved defects as a group and assign severity, priority, and ownership
questions.explain: A triage meeting, held regularly during active testing, reviews defects as a group rather than handling each one ad hoc, assigning severity, priority, and an owner.

questions.q: How was Brightfield's partial-payment defect (DEF-CM-04) rated?
options: Low severity, low priority
High severity, Critical priority
Not rated at all
Medium severity, deferred to backlog
questions.explain: DEF-CM-04 was rated High severity (it affects a routine transaction type) and Critical priority (it had to be fixed before UAT).
